description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by conform-0004. Cross-implementation byte-identity may be claimed only for the machine artefacts; a claim that lists HTML in that set is rejected and the rest of the claim stands.
note: added 2026-09-17 at rc.3 (DS-5, deferred-vector pass); unreleased, may be edited in place until the rc.3 tag
reason: Withdrawn at 1.0.0-rc.5 (V9A-27; D100). Its `accepted` array mixes two route spellings inside one byte-compared expectation — `graph.jsonld`, `graph.nq`, `search.json` and `chunks.jsonl` without a leading slash beside `/llms.txt` with one — so a port cannot tell whether the slash is significant. Superseded by conform-0004, which uses the AGSC-06-01 route form throughout.
